description: Preferred runway modes, owner-supplied 24-10-2026, in priority order (order in this file is the tie-break): equal first 0107AD and 1925AD (both runways together); then equal 01AD and 19AD (the main runway alone); then equal 07AD and 25AD (the crosswind runway alone). No crosswind limit or capacity has been supplied for any mode; they fall back to the pack default and have no capacity limit.
